description: Validate an IBAN: country length, mod-97 check digits, formatted output. Validates International Bank Account Numbers for 80+ countries: structure, country-specific length and the ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum. Returns the normalized and print-formatted IBAN, BBAN and (for DE/GB) the bank code / sort code. Offline; nothing is stored. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
